title: This Tiny Beetle Can Pull the Weight of Six Buses

scenes.text: This tiny beetle can pull six double-decker buses.
It's a horned dung beetle called Onthophagus taurus. Scientists tested it in a lab.
It pulled 1,141 times its own body weight.
For a person, that's like lifting six loaded double-decker buses. By yourself.
Researchers from Queen Mary University of London and the University of Western Australia measured it.
The strongest insect ever tested. Its day job is moving dung.

description:
This tiny beetle can pull six double-decker buses.
The horned dung beetle Onthophagus taurus pulled 1,141 times its own body weight in a lab test, which scientists compared to a 150-pound person lifting six loaded double-decker buses.
What is the strongest animal you know?
